summary.text: Todd Fahey is the Democratic candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Hillsborough 2, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An attorney, he said in a Ballotpedia survey that he is a Bedford native and managing partner of a New Hampshire law firm who also served as AARP New Hampshire's state director for eight years.

paragraphs.text: Fahey graduated from Manchester High School West, earned a bachelor's degree from Columbia University in 1989 and a law degree from the University of Maine School of Law in 1993, according to Ballotpedia.

In his survey, he said he has practiced law for nearly 30 years, took an eight-year break from law to serve as AARP New Hampshire's state director, and has taught courses at the University of New Hampshire law school.

He also said that governors of both parties appointed him to boards and commissions on prescription drug affordability, workforce and victims of crime, and that courts have appointed him to stabilize nonprofit organizations.
Fahey described himself as a trustee of the New Hampshire Historical Society and a past trustee of Catholic Charities New Hampshire, and said he has been recognized in The Best Lawyers in America.
Fahey listed local property taxes, public school funding, corporate taxation, energy policy, health policy and environmental protection as the policy areas he is most passionate about.
